name: Requiem: Possessed Grin
description: The ultimate Requiem addon, inspired by The Exorcist. Possession takes hold in three stages (Infestation, Oppression, Possession), and the body shows it: flickering white eyes, then a malicious grin and fangs, then blood, bruises and a corpse's pallor, with twitches, convulsions, a hanging head and a marionette lurch. The trapped soul of your body pleads and begs forgiveness; talk to or taunt any creature in chat and it answers in its own voice; your body's own kind won't fight you and come back to help; telepathy reads a creature's real thoughts. Demonic powers: levitation, telekinesis, the head turn, bile, poltergeist fury, an icy presence, a demon's voice, unholy strength and the spider-walk. Knocking walls, dying lights, holy water, cleric exorcists and an Ouija board. Possess the Warden, Wither and Ender Dragon with their real attacks, and even passive mobs can fight.
